title: Review of c42's closed condensate food chain (SIEXD) on fresh seed 21: predators divide to generation 2, prey divide only with predators present, fuel cut kills both; prey reach only generation 1 and E holds by construction
summary: Fresh labkit run on seed 21 (128^2, t=12000, --lineage-k 5): prey and predator condensates form from noise and coexist to the end (6 prey, 26 predator components). Predators: 30 persistent splits, max generation 2, merge/split 0.41, division by ring/arc fragmentation after eating a prey droplet (strips/s21_ch1.png). Prey: 7 persistent splits but max generation 1 on this seed; splits2.py finds 6 prey divisions after t=2000 against 1 in the matched predator-free twin (79 static prey droplets, rerun_nopred/seed21). Fuel fork at t=6000 on seed 21: prey 4 -> 0 by t=6100 and predators 31 -> 0 by t=6700, fed twin 10 prey and 34 predators at t=8000 (efork/). E is build-from-food (prey made only from fuel, predators only from prey material, both decay), so I mark it by construction, as the author does.

observations.S: rerun/seed21/sheet.png t=0: smoothed noise over the whole box; prey and predator droplets by t=500
observations.I: rerun/seed21/sheet.png: discrete prey droplets and predator droplets/rings/arcs, bounded size, both kinds present to t=12000
observations.X: rerun_nopred/seed21 (matched twin pred_on 0, same seed, grid, duration, K): 79 static prey droplets, 1 prey division after t=2000 vs 6 with predators (strips/s21_ch0.json vs nopred_s21_ch0.json); prey count with predators 6 at the end vs 79 without: predators lower prey numbers and turn a frozen emulsion into a dividing one; predators exist only on prey material
observations.D: predator species: 30 persistent splits (K=5), max generation 2 from noise-formed founders, merge/split 0.41 (rerun/seed21/FACTS.md); strips/s21_ch1.png t=2700-3400, 3300-4000, 6700-7400: rings left around eaten prey break into arcs that round up into separate predator droplets
observations.E: efork/cut_s21.png: fuel removed and its regrowth stopped at t=6000, prey 4 -> 0 by t=6100, predators 31 -> 0 by t=6700; fed twin efork/fed_s21.json 10 prey, 34 predators at t=8000

verdicts.limitation: D rests on the predators: on seed 21 the prey reach only generation 1 (7 persistent splits), below the claim's 2-6. Predator division is fragmentation of a ring formed around an eaten prey droplet; the predator body plan cycles droplet -> ring -> arcs, and the early splits (t<1000) are break-up of formation-phase filaments. Merge/split 0.41 for predators, close to the 50% reticulation cap. E is build-from-food: both species are made only from their food and decay, so dependence on fuel holds by construction. X is partly by construction on the predator side (predators are made only of prey). One fresh seed, 128^2 only.
